cases.description: A key of 31 bytes is skipped: no held entry has its key, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A key of 33 bytes is skipped: no held entry has its key, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
An empty key is skipped: no held entry has its key, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
The node's own interface key is skipped: no held entry has its key, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 10.128.0.1, above the pool is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 10.63.255.255, below the pool is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 11.64.0.1, outside 10.0.0.0/8 is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 10.64.0.5, inside the reserved 10.64.0.0/24 is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 10.64.0.255, the top of the reserved 10.64.0.0/24 is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 3 bytes is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip of 5 bytes is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
An IPv4-mapped tunnel_ip of 16 bytes is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
An empty tunnel_ip is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip6 of 1 byte is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip6 of 4 bytes is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip6 of 15 bytes is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A tunnel_ip6 of 17 bytes is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A valid_until one second past midnight is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A valid_until at noon is skipped: the held entry under its key is removed, the rest of the Delta applies and the gauge counts it.
A malformed entry inside a snapshot is skipped and counted; the rest of the snapshot applies.
A tunnel_ip6 of 16 bytes is kept: its entry replaces the held one, the rest of the Delta applies and nothing is counted.
A tunnel_ip of 10.64.1.0, the first address above the reserved 10.64.0.0/24 is kept: its entry replaces the held one, the rest of the Delta applies and nothing is counted.
A tunnel_ip of 10.127.255.255, the top of the pool is kept: its entry replaces the held one, the rest of the Delta applies and nothing is counted.
